methodology_other: Data were collected from the IX National Population and Housing Census, the 2015 Population Estimates and Projections, the 2016 Health Situation of the Population, the 2019 ENHOGAR-MICS Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey, the Wage and Labor Costs and Labor Market tables from the Oficina Nacional de Estadística (ONE), and the 2015 National Agricultural Precensus Results Report. Census Bureau staff altered boundaries and modified the statistical data as detailed in the Metadata tab of the tabular data.
name: dominican-republic-subnational-population-and-housing-data-tables-with-administrative-boundaries
notes:
The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first-, second-, third-, and fourth-order administrative divisions, aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided.

The tabular data contain total population for 2020 (population estimates), as well as five-year age group and sex, and information relating to households, housing units, health, economics, information and communication technology, and agriculture.
